arguments.name: source
arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

semantics.summary: Copies a selected source region to the destination while transposing source rows and columns. The source field remains unchanged.
side-effects: Writes the transposed region into the destination field.

notes: The page-image-reviewed material documents source preservation, matching-index behavior, and the vector-specific row/column requirements.
For vector operands, one vector must be explicitly dimensioned as a row vector and the other as a column vector; the command transposes the second vector before copying.
For vector extents, the effective dimension depends on source orientation; zero in the active extent performs no copy.
